items.caption: A received Shuowen small-seal form of 冷, reproduced as a modern vector. The account analyzes the graph as 仌 for meaning and 令 for sound.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style form of 冷 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This legible seal-style form illustrates the received Shuowen analysis of 冷. The component interpretation is a historical dictionary account, not independently established as the graph’s original formation.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector reproduction, not an excavated inscription. Available evidence does not establish an oracle-bone or bronze form, the graph’s earliest form, or whether the Shuowen analysis reflects its original formation. The exact historical sound correspondence between 冷 and 令 also remains unresolved.
